entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, the leader in connected fitness. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand. It's not working.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, may I have your order number please?
VF8819-25. Look, I don't have time for a long call, I just need the return instructions.
I understand you're busy. I've got your order right here for the VeloBand Pulse. So I can get you the right information, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. The product is garbage, it won't connect to my phone. I've tried everything.

I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing connectivity issues. That's certainly not the experience we want for our customers. I can either walk you through a quick reset procedure or transfer you directly to our technical support team who can verify the fault and arrange a replacement.
No. I don't have time for any of that. The thing is broken. I'm done with it, I just want my money back. Process the refund.
I understand your frustration, but for us to process a return for a defect, our policy requires that we first verify the fault. Without troubleshooting, I'm unable to do that from my end.
This is ridiculous. I'm telling you it's broken. I'm the customer. Just take it back.

I hear you, but I do need to follow procedure here. I see your order was delivered 12 days ago, on December 21st. The VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window. For claims made after that, like yours on day 12, we can only process an exchange for a technically verified defect.
So you sold me a piece of garbage and now you're telling me I'm two days too late to get my money back? I want a refund.

Without verification from our technical team, my system will not authorize a refund because we are outside the 10-day window. The policy is in place because the device activation links the hardware to a user's account for security. I can still transfer you to tech support to get this resolved with a working unit.
Forget it. It's clear you just want to keep the money. This is a complete waste of my time.
I assure you, that's not our goal. We are bound by the policies for these specific devices. Is there anything else I can help with?
No. You've been no help at all.
